title: How to find ghost locations in GTA 6? From the cursed cruise ship to haunted hotels, all encounters explained
content:
Exploring Leonida in Grand Theft Auto VI is not always about stealing cars, completing missions, or causing absolute chaos on the streets of Vice City. Players have been investigating haunted buildings, mysterious apparitions, unexplained voices, and strange supernatural encounters across the map. Some discoveries come with elaborate backstories and collectible rewards, while others remain community-reported sightings that players are still trying to reproduce.

From the

St. Lucia Lighthouse mystery

to the ghostly woman appearing on a car's hood, here’s a guide to the creepy locations, paranormal encounters, and supernatural Easter eggs in

GTA 6

.

St. Lucia Lighthouse: Find the ghostly lighthouse keepers and the cursed ship

One of the most elaborate reported paranormal mysteries in GTA 6 revolves around the St. Lucia Lighthouse on Little Hardin Island, located in the northeastern section of

Leonida County

.

Image credit :

X/ St. Lucia Lighthouse ghost

Players investigating the location have reported encountering two glowing green apparitions of former lighthouse keepers, Frank Peudney and Godfrey Asher. To trigger the reported sequence, visit the lighthouse at approximately 1:30 AM in-game. As you approach, you can reportedly hear two men arguing before witnessing one of them push the other off the tower.

However, the mystery doesn't end with the apparitions. At the base of the lighthouse, players can reportedly find an old photograph dated 1909, identifying the two lighthouse keepers.

The next clue is inside a ruined house near the lighthouse. Head towards its fireplace or chimney and knock down Frank's old logbook. The journal reportedly explains that Godfrey discovered a cursed chest washed ashore and began seeing a ghost ship every night. His obsession eventually escalated into violence, leading to the confrontation at the lighthouse.

There is a creepy ghost pirate ship in GTA 6 ☠️👻 https://t.co/wIhdpghwX7

— Interstellar (@InterstellarUAP) November 21, 2026

The mystery gets even stranger when players head towards the nearby pier and take the boat equipped with scuba gear. Travelling towards the eastern side of the lighthouse at approximately 1:30 AM reportedly triggers heavy fog, strange voices, and an engine failure. Diving underwater can lead to a shipwreck containing a skeleton and a unique melee weapon called the Cursed Knife.

Return to the lighthouse shore and look out towards the water for the reported ghost ship appearance. However, the full lighthouse sequence and its precise triggers should be treated as community-reported discoveries until independently reproduced.

Marbelle Hotel: Experience a Silent Hill-inspired nightmare

If abandoned buildings and creepy mannequins are your thing, the Marbelle Hotel is another location worth investigating. Situated in southern Crosstown, Vice City, near an interstate overpass and the Nine1Nine nightclub, this abandoned three-storey building reportedly hides an elaborate paranormal sequence.

The entrance has a For Sale sign, so players need to make their way around the building and enter through the rear door. Once inside, check the cabinet opposite the staircase for a collectible trading card called The Death of Swallow, from The Legends of Rat Face series. There's also a locked safe on the ground floor.

The real nightmare begins upstairs. Players have reported finding a mannequin standing motionless in a corner, with a metal pipe leaning nearby. Another room contains candles, occult symbols, a second mannequin lying on a bed and a disturbing message carved into the floor.

Image credit :

X/ Haunted hotel and hallway monster

Things get considerably stranger when players enter the stairwell. The door reportedly slams shut, the lights flicker and strange whispers fill the building. Glowing red markings appear across the walls, revealing the safe combination: 955214.

Step outside onto the rooftop and the surrounding streets are reportedly covered in thick fog, creating an atmosphere straight out of Silent Hill. Players can also find an Old Note containing a mysterious warning about the roof.

Return to the ground floor and enter the six-digit combination into the safe. The reported rewards include several thousand dollars, the Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast' luxury watch for Lucia and the The Truth Is Out There achievement or trophy.

Sassafras Road: Encounter the ghostly woman near the tunnel

Driving through Leonida's countryside at night might not seem particularly dangerous until your vehicle suddenly stops working and a mysterious figure appears out of nowhere. One community-reported encounter points towards Sassafras Road, particularly the tunnel along its isolated two-lane stretch.

According to player accounts, visiting the area around 2:30 AM can trigger thick fog and an unexpected vehicle breakdown. A pale, long-haired woman reportedly appears on the hood of the car. The tunnel itself is said to be equally disturbing, with reversed whispers and a woman's scream echoing through the darkness. Leaving the tunnel reportedly makes the sounds disappear.

On one of the roads in Leonida, a terrifying ghost suddenly appears while driving at night 🧟#GTA6 https://t.co/kOeuNBLe0T

— 🗽Game Source™ (@GameSourceTM) November 20, 2026

But the supposed jumpscare comes when players return to their vehicles. The ghostly woman can reportedly appear in the passenger seat, crying before lunging towards the camera and vanishing.

It's the kind of encounter that makes you reconsider travelling through deserted roads without a passenger.

Kelly County: Look out for the crawling hood ghost

Another reported roadside encounter takes place in Kelly County, where players have described seeing a mysterious pale figure emerging from thick green fog. Unlike the Sassafras Road account, this sighting reportedly involves a ghost appearing beside the vehicle's front wheel before crawling directly onto the hood.

The encounter is said to happen while driving along an isolated stretch of road at night. Once the fog rolls in, the vehicle reportedly stalls, leaving players with very little time to react before the apparition appears.

The two roadside ghost stories are often mixed together online, but they should be treated as separate reported sightings until their locations and triggers are independently verified.

Mount Kalaga National Park: Search for the interactive ghost

Mount Kalaga National Park is another location attracting attention from players investigating supernatural secrets. Community reports include sightings attributed to players exploring the park.

Image credit :

X/ Ghost sighting at mount Kalaga

Unlike the stationary ghost encounter from GTA V's Mount Gordo, this reported apparition supposedly reacts to the player's presence. Some accounts also mention the HUD temporarily disappearing and nearby lights flickering in unusual patterns, with players speculating that the flashes could resemble Morse code.

The reported encounter has been associated with approximately 4 AM in-game time, although it supposedly doesn't appear every night. Other reports suggest that the encounter might be affected by mission progression.

The sighting has been discussed by the community, but its precise spawn conditions and the alleged Morse-code clue remain unverified.

Lake Leonida: Look for the mysterious Ring-inspired girl

Horror fans might want to keep an eye on the Lake Leonida region, where community reports have pointed towards a strange female apparition.

The alleged sighting takes place around the Waning Sands, Bellville, and Leith River areas. The figure is described as a girl with long, dark hair covering her face, resembling Samara from the popular horror franchise The Ring.

However, there is currently no independently established trigger or precise location for the apparition, so players should treat this as an unverified sighting rather than a confirmed encounter.

Capri Sound: Investigate the abandoned warehouse and its ritual altar

For players interested in occult mysteries, an abandoned warehouse in Capri Sound, northeast of Tortoise Lake, has also been mentioned in paranormal discovery discussions.

The reported location contains a ritual altar surrounded by candles and a pentagram. According to community accounts, players need to knock an NPC unconscious, carry them inside, and place them in the centre of the summoning circle.

Image credit :

X/ Secret sacrificial ritual

Doing so supposedly triggers a strange supernatural sequence involving a disembodied voice directing the player towards the second floor. The encounter has also been associated with The Truth Is Out There trophy, although its exact relationship with the Marbelle Hotel sequence needs further verification.

Little Hardin Islands: Explore the mysterious concrete bunker

The paranormal mysteries around Little Hardin Island reportedly extend beyond the lighthouse.

On a southern island in the chain, players have pointed towards a sealed concrete bunker featuring a keypad. However, this discovery appears to be connected to a separate Cold War conspiracy mystery rather than a traditional ghost encounter.

The reported sequence begins at the War Memorial in central Vice City, where players can speak to a mysterious man referred to as the Strange Man. The character is believed to be a nod to Red Dead Redemption's mysterious figure.

THE GTA 6 SECRET BUNKER MYSTERY HAS BEEN SOLVED & INCLUDES A FREE TANK YOU CAN KEEP! 😱 https://t.co/4Qg5kY2ftn

— Jon (@MrDalekJD) November 21, 2026

After receiving the clue, players can head towards the bunker near Sharktooth Island and Little Hardin.

Inside, a tunnel leads to a power switch and a main room containing a photograph of President Russo meeting an alien on Mount Chiliad in 1962. The bunker also reportedly contains a telephone and a radio puzzle.

Interacting with the President's desk activates a radio transmission. Players then need to examine a classified document containing Protocol #2 (2341). Using the radio clues and the document reportedly reveals the safe combination 2975.

The safe contains President Russo's 1922 Pistol and a photograph pointing towards another bunker. Turning the photograph over reveals the word OBSESS, which reportedly translates into the second keypad code: 085355.

The second bunker allegedly contains a Cold War 556 Assault Rifle and access to a Mini Tank. Although it isn't a conventional ghost encounter, the mystery adds another layer to Leonida's collection of unexplained secrets and conspiracy theories.

Are there more ghost locations in GTA 6?

With Leonida offering such a massive world to explore, players are still investigating possible supernatural encounters and hidden Easter eggs.

Some of the other reported discoveries include a spectral passenger appearing in a car's rear-view mirror on isolated highways, strange ritual sites involving candles and effigies in the bayou, and additional unexplained lights around remote areas.

However, not every viral GTA 6 ghost video represents a new discovery. Several online lists have mixed up the game's alleged supernatural encounters with GTA Online's original Ghosts Exposed photography hunt, including its locations around Paleto Bay, Grapeseed, Raton Canyon and Mount Gordo.

This secret ghost encounter in GTA 6 is 100x scarier than Mount Gordo 💀 https://t.co/QWzpBrIM34

— Yashraj (@theyashraj7) November 22, 2026

For now, players should distinguish between repeatable in-game discoveries, community sightings and theories that still need proper verification. One thing is certain: Leonida has plenty of strange corners to investigate, and exploring them after midnight might not be the best idea.
